name: alicehr
description: Chrome extension MVP for job vacancy screening and ATS resume prompt generation

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/popup/popup.js && esbuild src/content/extractJob.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/content/extractJob.js && esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/background.js
scripts.copy-files: mkdir -p dist/popup dist/data && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup/popup.html && cp -r src/data/* dist/data/
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle && npm run copy-files
